random_seed.description: Reproducible simulated sample loss; integer seed.

camera_acquisition_delay_s.description: Delay before a captured camera image becomes available, seconds.

profile.description: Name reported in logs. The stress launcher overrides the profile and stress settings.

additional_processing_delay_s.description: Extra simulated processing delay beyond measured model runtime, seconds.

stress_additional_processing_delay_s.description: Extra delay selected by the stress launcher, seconds.

camera_dropout_probability.description: Probability of dropping each scheduled camera sample, 0 to 1.

range_dropout_probability.description: Probability of dropping each scheduled range update, 0 to 1.

maximum_vision_age_s.description: Stop when available vision is older than this age, seconds.

maximum_range_age_s.description: Stop when retained range measurements are older than this age, seconds.

maximum_acceleration_mps2.description: Maximum rise of commanded speed, metres/second squared.

maximum_deceleration_mps2.description: Maximum fall of commanded speed, metres/second squared; actual motion also depends on wheel physics.

range_update_period_s.description: Requested simulated sonar sample interval, rounded to controller steps.

vary_lighting.description: Vary scene illumination during the test.

animate_pedestrian.description: Animate the scripted walking person joints.

stop_clearance_requirement_m.description: Offline evaluation clearance criterion, metres. Does not set the motor stopping threshold.
